name: quantum-quill-local
description: Work with explicitly permitted local Quantum Quill projects. Start read-only; editing and manuscript access are controlled in QQ Settings.

origin.title: Local QQ address
origin.description: Keep QQ running locally. Only numeric loopback HTTP addresses with explicit ports are accepted.

key.title: Private QQ connection key
key.description: Create in QQ Settings → Agents. Paste here, never into a conversation. Replacing/revoking it in QQ removes access.
